brief.prompt: Hello, dear. It’s Nell. In Chapter 8 the Dwarf admits he thinks children are no help in a war. Then Edmund, Susan and Lucy each show him otherwise, and the five of them fill a raincoat with apples and row away from Cair Paravel. Build the boat on the shore below the ruins, with the well behind it and what each person brings aboard. Then tell me who takes which job.
